items.question: Has management given a complete list of related parties (owners, directors, their close family and businesses they control), and has the team checked it against registers and prior-year files?
Has the team asked management and those charged with governance about related party relationships and transactions, and recorded the answers?
Has the team looked for related party transactions in the records (loans to or from directors, unusual sales or purchases, rent, guarantees)?
Have significant transactions outside the normal course of business been identified and their business reason understood?
Have the terms of related party transactions been compared with market terms where the client says they are on arm-length terms?
Are related party balances and transactions agreed to supporting documents and to confirmation from the related party where possible?
Are the related party disclosures in the financial statements complete and agreed to the evidence?
